scope:
Cover every canonical first-component code of one fixed Gram.

Only a COMPLETE set of INFEASIBLE branches excludes the Gram. A single
fixed component, a time limit, or a satisfiable relaxation never does.
The code cover is computed from the exact filtered invariant component set.

four_corner_tables.test: Exact four-corner conditional PSD and four-signature sums.

first_component_normalization.action: Global mate flips and root relabelings preserving the complete fixed Gram and component template; no completed-graph automorphism assumed.

root_orbit_minimum.normalization: First component is minimum over its whole root orbit and all mate flips.

local_component_tables.scope: Every true connected line component is covered; no local witness is fixed.

nonroot_minimum_component_partitions.normalization: First occurrence in fixed colour class only.

component_signature_cuts.scope:
For a component union S of size6s at L, sum_S h+s*sum_L h=0.

Its balanced colours, internal degree3 and constant exterior degree s
give A(1_S+s1_L)=3(1_S+s1_L)+s1. Orthogonality to every -4 eigenvector
proves the identity. Bin membership and the eigenvector remain variables.
Indices in partitions refer to the full99 graph, Gamma has offset15.

line_profiles.scope:
Linearize common neighbours using complete outside rows at a root line.

For any root line r, its 36 neighbours split into the prescribed components
of size 6s. An outside vertex has exactly s neighbours in each component,
two neighbours of each colour. Its two colour-zero neighbours are fixed
by its label. Enumerate all four remaining neighbours (two in each star)
subject to these counts and already-forced edges. This uses no local seed.

All 276 C2 equations on pairs of star vertices split into an inside sum
over 24 vertices and an outside sum over 60 vertices. Profile indicators
make the latter linear. The few inside products are retained exactly.
For different components the inside sum is zero and the target is 1
for the same colour, 2 otherwise.

exact_triangle_structure.scope:
Exact lambda=1 using actual triangle indicators, plus triangle cores.

A Gamma edge sharing a root label already has its common neighbour in
N(o), so lies in no Gamma triangle. Every other Gamma edge lies in exactly
one. Indicators are equivalent to ALL THREE edges being present; merely
choosing an edge decomposition into triangles would be insufficient.

Under C1, every Gamma vertex then lies in exactly five Gamma triangles.
For the 60 vertices outside any root line and its neighbourhood, each
vertex lies in at least one core triangle, and there are exactly 32-t(l)
such triangles, where t(l) is the triangle count in the cubic neighbourhood.
If c(l)=6, those 60 vertices partition into exactly twenty triangles.

More precisely t_H(w)=1+e(C[N_C(w)]). In Gamma coordinates the second
term is the sum of the four possible shared-label star edges at w and
the actual triangles at w whose other two vertices are in the two stars.
These redundant equalities expose the local triangle balance to propagation.

triangle_sign_cuts.scope:
No strict same-sign triangle for an integral -4 vector of norm28.

For any line L, sum_{N(L)} h = -6 sum_L h, since each exterior
neighbour meets L exactly once. A strict same-sign triangle has absolute
sum at least3, hence opposite-sign mass at least18. But integral h with
norm28 and sum0 has each sign mass at most14. This proves the exclusion.
The argument does not use an assumed automorphism or a selected witness.

rotated_rectangles.scope:
No-three-edge rectangles at a root-neighbour after fixing its two stars.

Fixing a whole line neighbourhood fixes the six matched pairs in each of
its two Gamma stars. Each is a line through the corresponding original
root neighbour a. For two distinct such pairs, each cross pair has exactly
one common Gamma neighbour (the other common neighbour is a). Those four
vertices form a rectangle at a, so its induced edge count cannot be three.
The corners remain variables: no outside neighbourhood or witness is fixed.

In corner order00,01,10,11, a diagonal edge excludes every row/column edge:
otherwise its endpoint has two neighbours carrying the same mate label.
Together with E3 this leaves exactly15 edge patterns (one empty, six with
one edge, seven with two edges, and the single four-cycle of row/column edges).

integer_residuals.scope:
Realize the full integer residual of a variable rotated nine-set.

For x=1_S, |S|=9, put d=(A-3I)x-1. The SRG identity gives
Ad=-4d, sum(d)=0 and ||d||^2=56-14e, where S has14+e edges.
Thus e=4 forces A1_S=1+3*1_S at EVERY vertex. For e<=2 the
same exact norm controls all99 coordinates, not just known projections.

Here S consists of an original neighbour a, four fixed Gamma vertices
and four selected Gamma corners. The old root has residual zero. The
fourteen old-neighbour coordinates are label counts, and the84 others
are adjacency sums. We also impose the fourteen old-neighbour -4
equations, which are linear in these residual coordinates.

short_signature_cuts.scope:
For each rotated nine-set S, 8(sum_S h)^2 <= q*(64-16e-K).

Here h is an integral -4 eigenvector with norm squared7q, and e is the
number of edges among its four rectangle corners. The full projector is
E_-4=(3I-A+J/9)/7. The nine-set has14+e edges, so
1_S^t E_-4 1_S=(8-2e)/7. Cauchy--Schwarz proves the cut.
Every rectangle root a is one of the original fourteen neighbours, where
these h vanish; the four base and four corner coordinates are in Gamma.
Because h also vanishes on the original whole closed star, use its smaller
projector T/7. If d_b counts the eight Gamma vertices containing label b,
d_a=4 and d_{a*}=0. Put t_b=d_b-1 on the other twelve labels and
K=sum_{mate pairs b,c}(3(t_b^2+t_c^2)+2t_bt_c)>=0.
Then 1_{S Gamma}^t T 1_{S Gamma}=8-2e-K/8, giving the stronger cut.
For e=4 both K=0 (every other label used once) and sum_S h=0.
Corners remain variable, selected exactly; there is no boundary witness.

full_residual_component_identities.scope:
Transport component relations as FULL vectors, including the old line.

At the new root delta_ij=-T'1_Qij. For each incident line i,
sum_j delta_ij=0. Four nongrid rectangles must split into two opposite
pairs, since c>=4 forces two size12 components. The same pairing flags
are used for known short-vector projections and all residual coordinates.
Only a complete set of fifteen variable rectangles is used here.

component_template_cover.scope:
Transport the full c>=4 component-graph cover to a neighbouring root.

No prism budget is imposed at the new root. Use all200 component templates
(116 nongrid graphs), not the79 templates filtered at a low-prism root.
The new seven lines are the old-root line and the six fixed matched pairs
in its Gamma star. Only nongrid status is transported here; missing rotated
rectangles remain free Booleans in the necessary graph-cover table.
